whoami: I'm a Sevillian born in 2001. I studied Software Engineering Degree and a Masters Degree in Logic, Computing and Artificial Intelligence. Learning a bit more every day fills me with great joy and determination. I also have a great sense of responsibility and adaptability for every situation. I am specialised in Requirements Engineering, web development and Artificial Intelligence.

projects.title: Magazine Renovation System for the US
projects.description: During my time at the Library of the University of Seville, I designed and helped develop the magazine renovation system. It made the management process easier for the Library and the answer process simpler for the faculties. This project helped reduce the time required for all the stakeholders.

projects.title: Fundación Reinicias
projects.description: The project, designed exclusively for Fundación Reinicias, based in Granada (Spain), was also my Degree's Thesis. It is a web application divided into three sections: one for the team's management, another one for the patients and the last one for offering online courses. The main goal was making the information management easier for the organisation.

projects.title: CFB API (Continuous Feedback)
projects.description: It was a project for the subject Configuration Evolution and Management in my Degree. This API offers a simple way of linking a GitHub project with a Discord server to receive notifications about updates in the GitHub's repository, in a direct and convenient way.

projects.title: Petris
projects.description: Petris is one of the first projects I took a part in. A team of 6 classmates transformed a tabletop game into an online, real-time web game.

projects.title: panaLeria
projects.description: My first project was made by myself for a subject in my Degree. It is a social media webpage called panaLeria, in which users can upload pictures and share them with the community, filter by tags, trends, and more functionalities.
